clauses.quote: DCPS is prohibited from substantially changing the working conditions at any Improvement School during any school year.
DCPS must first negotiate such terms with the WTU.
the working conditions or compensation at the Improvement School shall remain the same as defined in this Agreement.
clauses.subject_text: the working conditions or compensation at the Improvement School
clauses.notes: Default status clause; no direct entitlement or duty assigned to a specific party.

clauses.quote: DCPS shall not discipline, retaliate against, or discriminate against any Teacher
and agrees to represent all employees in the bargaining unit without regard to WTU membership, within the provisions outlined in this Agreement.
clauses.notes: Continuation of section 3.2; split from preceding recognition clause.

clauses.quote: Any WTU Building representative who asserts retaliation, discrimination, or discipline based on the performance of his/her duties and responsibilities as a WTU building representative shall file a written request for informal mediation directly with the office of the Chancellor and the WTU President.
clauses.subject_text: Any WTU Building representative who asserts retaliation, discrimination, or discipline based on the performance of his/her duties and responsibilities as a WTU building representative

clauses.quote: The complaint shall be filed on a form developed and mutually agreed by the WTU and DCPS.
clauses.notes: Passive construction; implicit agent is the worker filing the request.

clauses.quote: The request must be filed within ten (10) school days following the date of the alleged act(s) by the supervisor.

The Chancellor or designee and the WTU President or designee shall meet with the Supervisor and Building Representative within ten (10) school days of receipt of the request in an effort to resolve the issue.
clauses.subject_text: The Chancellor or designee and the WTU President or designee

clauses.quote: the WTU Building Representative shall have the right to invoke STEP 1 of the grievance and arbitration procedure.
